description: Search security incidents in Nigeria, newest first. Filter by state, LGA, type code, status, confidence and date range. Bandit attacks are coded by what happened (KDN, MUR, CTR, TER), with the group in perpetrator_group. Results keep to the caller's archive window; archive.clamped says when an older date_from was cut.

lga.description: Local government area within the state, e.g. Gusau; needs state. Not available on the free view, which shows state only

state.description: Nigerian state, e.g. Zamfara, Akwa Ibom, FCT or Abuja

type.description: Incident type code: TER Terrorism, KDN Kidnapping, BOM Bombing/Explosion, ARB Armed Robbery, CMV Communal Violence, PRT Protest, SCM Scam/Fraud, MSP Missing Person, PIR Piracy/Maritime, ASN Assassination, CTR Cattle Rustling, GBV Gender-Based Violence, MUR Murder/Homicide, CLT Cult/Gang Violence, VAN Vandalism, LEO Law Enforcement, POL Political Violence, SFA Security Force Harm, OTH Other

name: search_incidents
title: Search incidents
